in_marathi.name: Ishani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of direction
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ishani is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Isha’ which means Goddess and ‘Ni’ which means direction. Ishani is the name of the Goddess who is believed to be the Goddess of directions. She is also known as the Goddess of the four cardinal directions – North, South, East and West. The name Ishani is also believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
